design.purpose: A sturdy two-tone storage basket for yarn, toys or household items, made by one beginner using both skeins.

steps.c: Place green yarn on the work surface
Place blue yarn beside the green yarn
Green: magic ring, chain 1 to start
Round 1: 6 single crochet in ring
Round 2: 2 single crochet in each stitch, 12
Round 3: repeat sc, 2 sc six times, 18
Round 4: repeat 2 sc, sc, sc six times, 24
Round 5: repeat sc, sc, sc, 2 sc six times, 30
Round 6: single crochet in back loop only, 30
Round 7: single crochet in each stitch, 30
Round 8: single crochet in each stitch, 30; join blue
Cut green yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail
Round 9: blue single crochet in each stitch, 30
Round 10: blue single crochet in each stitch, 30
Round 11: blue single crochet in each stitch, 30
Round 12: blue single crochet in each stitch, 30
Round 13: blue single crochet in each stitch, 30, slip stitch
Cut blue yarn, leaving a 15 cm tail; pull through
Weave both tails into nearby stitches with hook
Trim woven tails flush with the basket wall
